# Firdaus — full facts

Updated 13 November 2026. Site: https://firdaus.life (Russian) and https://firdaus.life/en/ (English).

## What it is

Firdaus is an iPhone app (iOS 17 or later) for Muslims who pray the five daily prayers. Its difference from other prayer apps: your loved ones (brother, sister, friend, mother) are inside the app, see whether you have prayed the current prayer, and can send you a gentle reminder card while the prayer time is still running. The app speaks Russian and English. It is made in Kazakhstan. An Android version is planned after the iPhone release.

Name: Firdaus (always in Latin letters). Tagline: "Firdaus — Remind your loved ones" (Russian: «Напоминай близким о намазе»).

The idea comes from Quran 51:55: «وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ» — "And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers" (Saheeh International); «И напоминай, воистину, напоминание приносит пользу верующим» (перевод Центра «Руввад»).

## Features

- Prayer times (время намаза) for your city. Kazakhstan: official DUMK timetable. Tatarstan: DUM RT timetable. Turkey: Diyanet. Elsewhere: the calculation method and madhab you choose. Works offline.
- Qibla (кибла): compass with a Kaaba marker and a map with a line to Mecca.
- Prayer reminder notifications.
- Marking a prayer with one tap. Optional strict prayer check with the camera; the photo is analysed on the phone and never uploaded.
- Loved ones and reminder cards: send a card with a Quran verse or a kind word; "Delivered" when they prayed after it. Cards can be sent as a link to people who do not have the app yet.
- Together: agree on a prayer; a lobby shows who is up; for Fajr the app wakes both people.
- Circle: a group of your people with a shared chat and a shared dhikr count.
- Quran: Arabic Uthmani text from Tanzil, Russian (Rwwad) and English (Saheeh International) translations offline, more languages from QuranEnc.com; bookmarks, continue where you stopped.
- Adhkar (morning and evening), tasbih counter, a shared dhikr count across the community.
- Tahajjud: the app calculates the last third of the night for your city and wakes you with a quiet alarm.
- Focus: choose distracting apps; at adhan time iPhone blocks them (Apple Screen Time) until you pray.
- Umma: feed, stories, replies; personal chats and groups, voice messages; Instants (a live photo to loved ones after prayer). Posts are checked before publishing; report and block are available everywhere.
- For sisters: days without prayer are marked privately and stored only on the phone.

## Prices and subscriptions

Free forever: prayer times, Qibla, prayer reminder, marking a prayer, Quran with one translation, simple tasbih, opening cards and Together invitations.

Firdaus Plus — the whole app, 7-day free trial (Apple):
- Kazakhstan: 3,790 KZT per month or 22,990 KZT per year
- USA: $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year
- Other countries: local price shown in the App Store before purchase

Firdaus Premium — everything in Plus, plus a golden crescent next to your name and priority support (stickers, emoji status and name colour are planned):
- Kazakhstan: 5,390 KZT per month or 32,990 KZT per year
- USA: $13.99 per month or $84.99 per year

Gifts: anyone can gift 1, 3 or 12 months of Plus with a card (painting, message, code). A gift waits in Settings → Gifts until the person turns it on.

"If you can't pay": a person writes a letter in the app; every month the team picks 50 letters and gives three months of Plus.

## Partner programme (for Islamic creators)

- 20% of the net revenue of every payment made by people who joined with the creator's code, for as long as they pay (net = price minus VAT, Apple's commission and a 4% tax). Example: Plus monthly in Kazakhstan, 3,790 KZT → 533 KZT to the partner.
- 5% of payments by friends invited by the partner's people: one level, 12 months, under the partner agreement. Nothing is paid for recruiting other partners; there is no fee to join.
- Payouts monthly, from the 10th, for the month before last, once the balance reaches 10,000 KZT.
- The creator's people get 30 days of Firdaus Plus and a golden crescent for 30 days.
- Partners get a "Firdaus Partner" badge and Firdaus Premium while the partnership lasts.
- Apply: https://firdaus.life/en/partners or partners@firdaus.life.

## Privacy

- Never leaves the phone: prayer-check photos, precise location, the cycle calendar, the list of apps chosen for Focus.
- Stored on the server (Supabase) only after sign-in with Apple or Google: profile, prayer marks, loved ones, cards, messages, posts.
- Service providers: Supabase (database), Apple (sign-in, payments, push), Google (sign-in), RevenueCat (subscriptions), Expo (push), OpenAI (automatic moderation of public posts, photos and names, only with consent), PostHog (analytics, EU, IP geolocation off), Sentry (crash reports), LiveKit (live audio, not recorded).
- No ads, no tracking across apps, data is not sold. Account deletion in Settings removes the data.
- Age: 13+.
